objective: Backfill ISCAM mensual seguro ESTELAR 202601; solo Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto; omitir dias ya conciliados; escribir solo OK_HEADER_CANONICO; no tocar Runtime, Sync_Sales, pagos, cortes, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: estelar_202601_parity
queries.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(18,4))) ventas,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-01-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-02-01' GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)), d AS (SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(18,4))) ventas,COUNT(DISTINCT id_transaccion) tickets,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-01-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-02-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)) SELECT COUNT(*) problem_days FROM r LEFT JOIN d ON d.fecha=r.fecha WHERE (ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas,0))+ISNULL(r.tickets,0)+ISNULL(r.pax,0))>0 AND (d.fecha IS NULL OR ABS(r.ventas-d.ventas)>0.05 OR r.tickets<>d.tickets OR r.pax<>d.pax)
